frozen_predictor: arithmetic mean of frozen Agent A and Agent B probabilities

methods.mean_probability: APS after arithmetic mean of probabilities
methods.mean_score: mean of per-view APS candidate-label scores
methods.logmeanexp: cardinality-normalized LogMeanExp of per-view APS scores; tau selected only on risk_design
methods.pairrisk: mean maximum over all unordered pairs of per-view APS scores

primary_estimand: PairRisk minus max-score average prediction-set size at 90% nominal marginal coverage
mandatory_mean_interpretation: report singleton rate, conditional singleton consistency, and safe singleton yield; do not claim universal dominance
final_test_access: forbidden until design decision, code freeze, and calibration freeze
forbidden_actions: load or inspect final_test before protocol completion
select methods or tau on risk_calibration
treat image pairs as independent observations
retrain or replace frozen disease classifiers
